text: あなたのこと　かわいがって　るんだ

structure.jp: かわいがって　るんだ
structure.en: she really dotes on, I see

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: る here is the casual short form of いる; ている says something is ongoing. かわいがって　る = 'is doting on'.

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a person means that person as the one feelings are aimed at; it adds no word in English. あなたのこと = 'you'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ; here the speaker has just worked something out. かわいがって　るんだ = 'so she dotes on you'.
